subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) A caravan of merchants was attacked by a gang of robbers and one of the robbers said that the small boy might have something with him. (b) She advised him never to tell a lie. (c) He also said, “Mother has advised me never to tell a lie even in danger.” (d) Hazrat Abdul Quader’s mother decided to send Quader to Baghdad with a view to educating him there. (e) Boy Abdul Quader spoke out, “No, no, I have forty gold coins sewed in my shirt”. (f) The gang leader said that perhaps the boy had nothing with him. (g) That time roads were unsafe; often gangs of robbers fell upon the travellers and plundered their belongings and money. (h) The robbers felt ashamed of their deeds and gave up robbery.
guide_solution: d → b → g → a → f → e → c → h.
